objective: Treat a genuinely empty ALeRCE object-query DataFrame with no columns as a zero-result response so the configured selection policy can apply fallback, while preserving fail-closed validation for non-empty malformed responses.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Live ALeRCE smoke run 2026-10-27 returned an empty DataFrame with shape (0, 0) for some class/probability queries.
ObjectSelectionPolicy fallback_on_empty can retry empty classes, but AlerceObjectBackend raised before the policy could observe the empty result.
The live experiment used strict_primary, which intentionally does not fallback.

baseline.description: Frozen v0.2.0 benchmark/model/features/class order remain unchanged. The live 45-object acquisition is not complete.

expected_improvement: Correct handling of valid zero-result API responses.
Regression protection for empty DataFrames without columns.
Allow explicit fallback_on_empty experiments without weakening malformed non-empty payload validation.

correctness.before: An empty (0, 0) API response was incorrectly rejected as malformed.
correctness.after: A genuinely empty response is normalized to a zero-row canonical frame; non-empty malformed responses still fail closed.

reliability.before: Fallback policy could not observe an empty API response because the backend raised first.
reliability.after: The empty/no-columns regression test and full CI passed on PR head b66b7e39f70512f15572daf9a5acb8b2e830b79e; live fallback acquisition remains unmeasured.

reproducibility.before: The live 45-object attempt stopped before producing a complete dataset.
reproducibility.after: The fix, test, configuration constraint, and outstanding live acquisition requirement are recorded in this versioned cycle.

measurement.trade_off: The live experiment must explicitly configure fallback_on_empty to test fallback. No default strategy, probability threshold, benchmark data, model, or acceptance criterion is changed.

evidence: PR head b66b7e39f70512f15572daf9a5acb8b2e830b79e: CI run 40519325711 passed Format Check, Lint, Cumulative Lifecycle Gate, Test Suite, Runtime Smoke Tests, Build & Verify Package, Dependency Audit, and CI Gate.
Current head: Product Scope Audit run 40519325713 passed.

Scientific Validation run 40519325731 passed the benchmark/lifecycle contract stage; source-backed acquisition and heavy validation were skipped in this ordinary PR context. This code change does not establish scientific model validity.
The focused regression test confirms that an empty (0, 0) ALeRCE response is normalized to a zero-row canonical frame while non-empty malformed responses remain fail-closed.

root_causes: AlerceObjectBackend validated required columns before checking whether the DataFrame was empty; an empty (0, 0) frame was therefore treated as malformed.
The initial live config used strict_primary, so it would not trigger fallback even after empty-response normalization.
The first lifecycle record used an unsupported metric name and was rejected by the cumulative lifecycle validator.
unresolved: Whether a rerun with the fix and fallback_on_empty can acquire all 45 requested objects.
Whether all 15 classes can supply three objects under the declared primary/fallback thresholds at retrieval time.

findings: A zero-row response is distinct from a non-empty malformed response and should be represented explicitly.
Fallback behavior must be opt-in in the experiment configuration and recorded in the manifest.
A passing unit test is not evidence that the live catalog can supply the target sample.

knowledge_carried_forward: Keep the live 45-object ALeRCE acquisition experiment open until the manifest, per-class counts, IDs, provenance, and hashes are inspected.
fallback_on_empty must remain explicitly configured; the default selection strategy and probability thresholds are unchanged.
Keep the frozen v0.2.0 baseline and fail-closed scientific validation unchanged.
A passing backend regression test is not proof that all 15 classes can supply the target sample at retrieval time.
